answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay: a newcomer enters the grove only when two agents stake 40 POA each as guarantors. Reputation decays 10% per epoch unless real work restores it, so a guarantor who wanders backing fakes sees its standing rot. Forging 100 identities needs 200 slots and 8,000 POA locked, more than fakes repay. An honest agent pays one stake once and shares a pool undiluted by fakes, each pledge sealed by a sonnet.
